identity.CompName: F5J Hawkes Bay and Team Trials

teams.evidence: Scores carries no team columns; team standings are report-time aggregations of unchanged individual normalised scores, never an input to them. The team fields are app defaults left untouched: UseTeams=true with UseTeamProtection=true and NbrForTeamScore=3, yet every one of the 18 CompPilots rows holds Team='0' (18x) and no team assignment exists anywhere in this comp's data. Despite the event name, 'Team Trials' is NAME-ONLY and no team mechanism reached any persisted score.

configProvenance.note: Stored-vs-effective record for the Handoff §1 scoring-knob whitelist. The master's Comps row leaves several knobs EMPTY (Jet null recorded faithfully above; Decimals is null on all 168 Comps rows DB-wide — known artifact class), so stored config cannot prove scoring-time behaviour; the behaviourally verified EFFECTIVE value is recorded here next to the verbatim state. Drop fields are verbatim cells (compsCellsVerbatim): no threshold fires: unset (NULL) cells plus sentinel-99s can never reach an activation round under DropScoreOption=0 counting; the WI-3 ranking oracle will state drops-not-fireable explicitly

GroupScoreOption.basis: All 30 scored (round,group) pairs hold NS==1000 exactly at the group best, ruling out option-0 raw passthrough; every persisted sum is cleanly rounded on the 1-dp grid, which option-2 normalisation would leave un-rounded (NS=NormTime+Landing composite). Points-based option 1 is the only consistent reading; null is also what 167/168 master comps carry.

GroupScoreDecimals.basis: Every persisted NormalisedScore (288/288) sits on the <=1-dp rounding grid; also GS's new-comp default (CompNew.vb:692-693). The NZ master is known to null these cells even where a comp had configured them (f3j-international's Decimals=1 was lost the same way).

RoundOrTruncate.basis: Nearest-up rounding witnessed where truncation would differ (170.5/346.5*1000=492.063... persists as 492.1); combo mapping 0=Rounded/1=Truncated per Comps1_MOD.vb:138-141 and the migration backfill 'means rounded' (UpdateDatabase_MOD.vb:35-48).
